thread:
jordan: heads up — prod is showing a bump in websocket disconnects + a lot of partial chunks for /v1/stream starting ~10:12am PST. client reports getting truncated JSON chunks then socket close. sample req: req_83a2b
ash: saw it. first things I check: Grafana panel `infra-ws` (streaming tab) for chunk latency and chunk count. also look at the disconnects rate panel. quick PromQL I use: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ws_chunk_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))` and `sum(rate(ws_disconnects_total[5m])) by (reason)`
marie: for logs, Loki query to find matching reqs: ```{app="ws-gateway"} |= "disconnect" | json | req_id="req_id" |~ "req_83a2b"``` then expand around +-1m. also try: ```{app="ws-gateway"} |= "partial_response" | json | req_id="req_id"```
sre-oncall: fwiw I got an alert spike at the same time for node autoscaler flapping. check node-scaler events and `kube_node_events_total` around 10:10-10:15. if nodes were being drained/recreated that might cause in-flight WS drops.
deploy-bot: Deployed `ws-gateway` commit abc123 to prod at 2026-03-10T10:11:28Z (canary -> 3 pods) :rocket:
ash: good catch — that deploy time lines up. two possible causes: (1) a transient restart/drain during rollout closing connections, (2) backend timeout or backpressure causing gateway to send partial frames and close. to differentiate, check: (a) pod restart count + termination signals (`kubectl get events`), (b) backend latency (prom metric `backend_request_latency_seconds`) for that period.
jordan: how should we tune alerts? current disconnect alert fires at 1% over 5m and has been fairly noisy during normal deploys.
ash: propose changing to `for: 10m` and threshold to 3% to reduce deploy noise, and add `on: (cluster, route)` labels so it doesn't aggregate across clusters. example alert rule snippet:
```yaml
- alert: HighWebsocketDisconnectRate
  expr: (sum by (cluster, route)(rate(ws_disconnects_total[10m])) / sum by (cluster, route)(rate(ws_connections_total[10m]))) > 0.03
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    description: "Websocket disconnect rate > 3% for 10m on {{ $labels.route }}"
```
marie: also suggest adding a short-term debug trace sampling bump for the route (`/v1/stream`) for 30-60 minutes so we can get full spans for the truncated streams. change sampler to 10% for that route in jaeger-agent config, then revert.
sre-oncall: I'll correlate k8s events + autoscaler logs and post back. if it's rollout-related we should add a runbook note about graceful drain config for ws-gateway (gracefulTerminationPeriodSeconds, preStop hook to drain connections).
